parameters.interpretation: One world_len initializes wsx/wsy. Drawing ac literal1e-6; diameter2radius; nx/ny truncated before expanded widths. No YAML parser or true cell-space behavior claimed.

lattice.square: Two rand(ny,nx) blocks, x then y, even disorder0; row-major flatten. Inclusive linspace endpoints use native drawing gap.
lattice.HEX: Source uses expanded wsx for y and wsy for x, with native truncated blue/red counts. Entire blue cloud then entire red cloud; source comment interleave is not elementwise alternation. Linspace spacing need not equal nominal a_hex/b_hex.
lattice.bbox: Centroid excludes bbox. Append unexpanded extrema corners BL,BR,TR,TL without dedup; separate bounds/bbox expand by radius.

centroid_reduction.original_points: xypts: vstack transpose, original strides captured before copying
centroid_reduction.stored_points: Immutable C-order snapshot; no recomputation of source centroid from stored layout

caller.branch: SEED phase and svg_override=False reaches _make_cell_lattice before make_voronoi. Phase guard/callbacks/YAML are outside this normalized scalar-controls component.
caller.next_stage: Image picker/mask and mesh preparation follow; no execution of clipping/filter/merge/refinement in this package.

stream: Owned complete legacy MT19937 state; local replay, no process-global RNG mutation, no seed reseeding/world-hash convention. Cached Gaussian metadata retained under uniform draws.
ownership: Occurrence IDs distinguish bbox duplicates; no physical cell identity, removal, merge or cross-generation mapping.

type_check.body:
def type_check(func: CallableTypes) -> CallableTypes:
    return func
type_check.semantics: Execute the authenticated native decorator AST. Its pinned body returns func; no invented identity replacement. Original lattice annotation/decorator AST remains unchanged; compiler postpones annotations.
type_check.package_import_hook: Not executed by the isolated harness. Normalized scalar recipe and complete MT stream are validated explicitly; native Parameters/beartype import-hook parity is outside this boundary.

wrapper_verification.parameters: Exact eight original Assign nodes, in source order, checked before compile
wrapper_verification.lattice: Exact original function AST including annotations and type_check decorator, checked before compile
wrapper_verification.decorator: Exact original type_check AST checked before compile
wrapper_verification.compiler: __future__.annotations flag, no annotation evaluation or body rewrite
wrapper_verification.raw_layouts: Original source shapes/dtypes/strides/C/F flags retained before K-order copies; centroid assertions reconstruct source F order
